description: Toggles the lock state of a layer; locked layers cannot be edited on the canvas. Undoable.

members.name: ToggleLayerLockCommand
members.description: Creates the command for the layer to toggle.

members.name: Name
members.description: Human-readable label shown in undo/redo tooltips.

members.name: Execute
members.description: Applies the change to the document.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Restores the state captured before Execute() ran.
